title: Try/fail cycle artefact (narrative)
description: Conflict-attempt-result chain. The protagonist pursues a goal through escalating attempts, each meeting an obstacle that either advances or redirects the pursuit. Used by paradigms that foreground active protagonist agency (classic three-act, hero's journey ordeal phase, Save-the-Cat fun-and-games).

goal.description: What the protagonist is trying to do (the external want, typically).

action.description: What the protagonist tries at this attempt.

obstacle.description: What prevents the attempt from succeeding (or, on a success cycle, what made it costly).

result.description: Outcome class. success = goal advanced; success-pyrrhic = goal advanced at unexpected cost; fail-recoverable = setback that motivates the next attempt; fail-fatal = ends the pursuit.

escalation.description: Optional: how this attempt's outcome raises the stakes for the next cycle.

finalOutcome.description: Optional: classification of the chain's terminus.
